data.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

## What
Fix the ancestry-path check direction in defense_store_load_for_region.

Current (wrong): checks if QUERY_SHA is in 'git log --ancestry-path BASE..TIP'
Correct: checks if TIP is an ancestor of QUERY_SHA (i.e., 'git merge-base --is-ancestor TIP QUERY_SHA')

This means: the story's tip SHA must be in the ancestry of the query context (merge commit).
When a story is merged, TIP becomes an ancestor of MERGE_COMMIT, so the attestation survives.

## Fix in plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh

Replace the git log ancestry-path block (in defense_store_load_for_region) with:
  if git -C "$_repo_root" merge-base --is-ancestor "$tip_sha" "${DSO_QUERY_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)}" 2>/dev/null; then
    # TIP is an ancestor of QUERY_SHA → record survives the merge
    echo "$record"
  else
    echo "WARN: SHA-range check failed (TIP not ancestor of QUERY_SHA)" >&2
  fi

## Tests that must pass after fix
- tests/review/test-defense-store-merge-survival.sh → PASSED: 2 FAILED: 0
- tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh → PASSED: 9 FAILED: 0 (no regressions)
- tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh → PASSED: 5 FAILED: 0 (no regressions)
data.title: GREEN: fix ancestry-path direction in defense_store_load_for_region for merge survival (story 8c9c)
